description: Check a public WooCommerce store from the outside: is it reachable, is HTTPS valid and are redirects sane, is WooCommerce detected, do /cart/ and /checkout/ load, and are payment markers visible on checkout. Read-only: GET requests only, never adds to cart, logs in or submits forms. Returns pass/warn/fail findings. Pass a bare hostname or URL; paths are ignored and the host's homepage is checked.

url.description: The store's public address, for example https://example.com. A bare hostname (example.com) is fine. Any path, query or fragment is ignored: the homepage of the host is checked.

name: check_store

reportUrl.description: Shareable read-only report page. The result is encoded in the link; nothing is stored.

status.description: checked = findings below; otherwise no store request was made.

url.description: Normalized store origin that was checked.

title: Check a WooCommerce store
